Coram : N.V. RAMANA*, S. ABDUL NAZEER
Penal Code, 1860: s.302 – Unnatural death by burn injuries – Prosecution case was that the appellant-accused poured kerosene on the victim-deceased and burnt her alive – Trial court convicted appellant under s.302 on the basis of dying declarations of the victim – High below arrived at concurrent findings after thoroughly assessing the circumstances and facts – The dying declaration of the deceased was recorded by the Special Executive Magistrate after obtaining the fitness condition of the victim by the duty Medical Officer who issued the fitness
Decision Date : 06-02-2018 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1025/2011 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
